final_round: uses final_round_generations and final_round_seed_budget; set each equal to its normal-round counterpart for no custom finale
seed_budget_precedence: round 1 uses opening_seed_budget; later final rounds use final_round_seed_budget; other later rounds use reinforcement_seed_budget

multiplayer.create: POST /matches with mode multi and max_players from 3-8
multiplayer.start: the match enters commit phase automatically when every seat is filled

life_counting: every player color and neutral cell are equally alive for B3/S23 neighbor counts
survival: every live cell, including neutral, survives with two or three live neighbors and retains its current color
birth: a dead cell is born with exactly three live neighbors; neutral neighbors count toward those three
ownership: a newborn takes the unique most common player allegiance among its three live parents; any tie is neutral; neutral parents do not bias an allegiance
tie_note: one red plus one blue plus one neutral is neutral; one each from three players is also neutral
collision: if two or more players seed the same dead cell, it becomes neutral life
score: each player's score is their allegiance's current live-cell count; neutral cells score for nobody

commitment.placement_order: sort by y ascending, then x ascending
commitment.commit_timeout: 24 hours from the moment the commit phase begins; missing committers forfeit
commitment.reveal_order: after every commitment is locked, any player may reveal first
commitment.reveal_timeout: 24 hours from the moment the reveal phase begins; missing revealers forfeit
